purpose: Independent descriptive timing-quality review. No data were excluded, no model was refitted, and no thresholds were changed.
limitations: Telemetry snapshots are at case boundaries, outside event timing intervals; they cannot establish in-event clock/temperature causes.
The repeat is a later shape-only subset on the same recorded GPU, not a different-day or different-device reproduction.
Within-visit stability, between-visit stability, cross-stage repeatability and prediction error are separate properties.
Checkpoints are verified receipts in the archive; the final Google Drive copy outcome is outside this archive.
